text: Added zero-allocation opaque CanonicalArray and MutableCanonicalArray refinements for whole canonical arrays, with checked logical C-order access and no storage/offset escape. Focused JVM and Scala.js suites pass 6/6 each. ScalaFIM HalfFlow workspace consumes it and focused registration suites pass 21/21 on both platforms. Short JMH is noisy: first workspace run 11.320 ms/op at 86.4 B/op exposed Either allocation; direct require fixed allocation to 54.313 B/op, but immediate timing rerun varied to 18.571 ms/op while comparator shifted. Keep open pending same-run primitive oracle and calm-host receipt.
